seo.title: Factors of 24 Game - Number Pairs & Divisibility Speed Clicker
seo.metaDescription: Find all factor pairs of 24 on a 100-number grid. Fast-paced math practice reinforcing divisibility and multiplication facts.
seo.intro: Factors are numbers that multiply together to produce a given product without leaving any remainder. The number 24 is a composite number with multiple distinct factor pairs. Finding factors on a 100-number grid helps students connect factor pairs such as 1 and 24, 2 and 12, 3 and 8, and 4 and 6, fostering algebraic reasoning and preparing for fraction simplification. Fluency Development: When students engage in timed identification on a 100-number grid, they move beyond manual finger-counting and transition into visual pattern synthesis. Developing automaticity with this specific math concept reduces cognitive load during multi-step problem solving, long division, and algebraic equation manipulation.
seo.howToPlay: Identify and click all numbers between 1 and 100 that divide evenly into 24. Correct factors turn green with a checkmark. Ineligible numbers flash red and penalize 2 seconds from your timer. Find all 8 factors to complete the round. Keyboard and Accessibility Controls: Students can use a touchscreen, trackpad, mouse, or keyboard arrow keys to navigate between tiles. Pressing Space or Enter activates the focused tile. Wrong clicks temporarily flash red with an X icon and subtract 2 seconds, but remain unlocked so learners can self-correct without getting stuck.
seo.teacherNotes: Have students write factor pairs on scratch paper as they play. Highlight that factors come in partner pairs (1 x 24, 2 x 12, 3 x 8, 4 x 6). Classroom Implementation Ideas: Use this interactive grid during the first five minutes of math instruction as an energetic bell-ringer or daily warm-up. Teachers can project the screen onto an interactive whiteboard for whole-class competitive rounds, or assign the canonical link directly into Google Classroom for independent Chromebook math station rotations.

faq.q: What are all the factors of 24?
faq.a: The positive integer factors of 24 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 24.

faq.q: Why is 24 considered an abundant number?
faq.a: An abundant number is one where the sum of its proper divisors exceeds the number itself. The proper divisors of 24 sum to 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 6 + 8 + 12 = 36, which is greater than 24.

faq.q: How does mastering click all factors of 24 support higher-level math standards?
faq.a: Building speed and accuracy with click all factors of 24 directly strengthens mental arithmetic and numerical reasoning. When foundational number facts become second nature, students can dedicate their active working memory to advanced problem-solving strategies, fraction equivalence, and multi-step word problems.
